label: has metal element present
definition: A relation between a microbial community and a CHEBI chemical entity that represents a metal element (atom or cation) present in or processed by the community.
observations: 0..* cardinality. Range is the broad CHEBI:24431 (chemical entity) because the schema-side MetalElementEnum mixes atom-form (e.g., CHEBI:27214 uranium atom, CHEBI:29287 gold atom) and cation-form (e.g., CHEBI:29033 iron(2+) cation) values; a narrower CHEBI parent would reject some valid existing data.

label: has rare earth element present
definition: A relation between a microbial community and a CHEBI chemical entity that represents a rare-earth element (atom or cation) present in or processed by the community.
observations: 0..* cardinality. Range is the broad CHEBI:24431 (chemical entity) for consistency with the metal-element predicate; the per-REE leaves in RareEarthElementEnum are all CHEBI cation-form entities (e.g., CHEBI:32359 lanthanum(3+) cation).

label: has metal relevance
definition: A relation between a microbial community and a metal-relevance-level class indicating how central metal or rare-earth-element cycling is to the community (primary defining function vs significant participant vs incidental vs not applicable).
